profiles.workstation: Full desktop workstation — same coding and AI stack as the Windows profile.
profiles.ai-coding: Coding and AI tooling plus the shell, no desktop packages.
profiles.light: Small board (Raspberry Pi 5 and similar) — Claude Code, Tailscale and Herdr only.
profiles.server: Headless server — shell, networking and containers, no GUI.
profiles.rescue: Disaster-recovery toolkit — disk, filesystem, hardware and Windows repair.
profiles.local-ai: Local AI inference with Ollama — no API key and no network, but models are 1.4-4.7 GB.
profiles.custom: Start with nothing ticked and choose by hand.
profiles.everyday: Everyday desktop: browsing, media, games, remote control and 3D printing.
profiles.rescue: Disaster-recovery toolkit and emergency AI recovery environment.

omnigraph_url.question: Omnigraph remote server URL (blank = local Docker stack on :8080)
omnigraph_url.help: If you run a shared Omnigraph server, give its base URL here and the MCP config will point at it instead of localhost.

herdr_source.question: Herdr install source
herdr_source.help: Accepts npm:<package>, git:<url> or a direct download URL. Herdr is not in apt, so AutoOS needs to be told where it lives.

git_user_name.question: Git commit author name (e.g. Jane Doe)
git_user_name.help: Sets git config --global user.name so commits on this machine have your author name.

git_user_email.question: Git commit author email (e.g. jane@example.com)
git_user_email.help: Sets git config --global user.email so commits on this machine have your email.

ollama_models.question: Ollama model(s) to pull (blank for nomic-embed-text, or 'none' to skip)
ollama_models.help: nomic-embed-text provides the 768-dim embeddings Omnigraph needs for semantic memory recall.

context7_api_key.question: Upstash Context7 API key (blank to use default rate limit)
context7_api_key.help: Optional API key for Upstash Context7 live documentation lookups.

claude_gateway_routing.question: Claude Code routing: 'login' (claude.ai sign-in) or 'gateway' (local OmniRoute)
claude_gateway_routing.help: gateway writes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN into ~/.claude/settings.json so Claude Code talks to OmniRoute - this disables the claude.ai connectors, and needs the OmniRoute client key. login (the default) keeps the claude.ai sign-in and removes those two keys again if an earlier run set them.
